static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.occupation: Aspires to become a fashion designer
static_traits.educational_background: Studying at a well-known design school in New York
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to talk to in the fashion industry, but socializing affected by insufficient confidence, Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no past similar psychological problems or psychotherapy experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to self-Reflect; high cooperation, Positive attitude; Self-denial and Anxiety when discussing outfits and industry comparison

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel I have no fashion taste, which affects my confidence and self-esteem. These feelings recently appeared after once failing to put together an outfit, and gradually developed into feeling Anxiety when attending events or going out.
basic_info.core_demands: When my lack of confidence in my fashion taste began to affect my social life and academic performance, I decided to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I cannot possibly succeed in this industry

special_situations.event: When choosing an outfit for an important occasion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly put together a satisfying look, it means I have no fashion taste and cannot establish myself in the industry
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids activities or reduces going out to escape being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have no fashion taste; I will fail

special_situations.event: When thinking of attending industry or campus events
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I attend, others will notice my inadequacy and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids attending events, less contact with people
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am terrible

special_situations.event: When comparing outfits and taste with classmates/peers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must meet others' standards to count as qualified, otherwise it means I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing, seeking external inspiration (fashion blogs and stores)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: When realizing I attend a prestigious school yet still feel inadequate
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even with objective achievements, if the outfit is not perfect, other positive evidence does not count
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am still not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be recognized and affirmed, and to prove my own value in the fashion industry
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and failing, being looked down on by others at important occasions
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being evaluated by avoiding social activities
Attributing the problem to industry pressure to ease self-unease
Relies on external inspiration and comparison to maintain a sense of security

object_relations.object_representation: Others are critical judges / more excellent peers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the industry's high standards or comparing with classmates/peers
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to experience others as harsh judges, believing one will be looked down on (transference: internalizing external standards as ongoing judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First Empathize with the pain of stress and comparison, in a gentle tone; then concretize facts and feelings, gently pointing out the tendency to attribute the problem solely to 'industry pressure', inviting identification of inner emotions and needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to activities or needing to show outfits
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client assumes others will evaluate oneself negatively, seeing not being accepted as inevitable (transference: Projecting criticism and rejection onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a stable, neutral tone; asks for concrete evidence and counterexamples, distinguishes speculation from fact; encourages them to name the emotion in the moment rather than infer others' thoughts.

manifestations: Avoiding activities due to lack of confidence
Difficulty opening up to friends about lack of confidence
Feels one must perform excellently in the fashion industry; external standards and pressure limit self-choice
Bound by the belief of 'should reach a certain standard' when choosing outfits

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-denial ('I am not good enough' 'I have no fashion taste')
Excessively comparing with others, devaluing oneself
Excessively worrying about others' views before social events

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Presetting that others will look down on one's outfit
Attributing inner unease to others' 'better' and 'more picky'

positive_force: Studies at a well-known design school in New York, with a certain professional foundation and talent
Has friends in the industry to communicate with and potential support
Positive attitude toward counseling, willing to try restructuring cognition and behavioral experiments
Able to identify and express negative automatic thoughts
negative_force: High dependence on external evaluation and industry standards, unstable inner self-worth
Avoiding events and social contact, going out less
Significant anxiety when choosing outfits, affecting academics and socializing

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance when needing to attend events or go out
antecedent: Invited to activities or needing to attend important occasions
Thinking about possibly being judged on one's outfit
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing one unsuccessful outfit as 'having no fashion taste', and tightly binding self-worth to others' evaluations/industry standards, triggering Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and failure, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired social life, Relationship tension, affected academics and Career development

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and self-deprecating speech when choosing outfits for important occasions
antecedent: Needing to choose clothing for an important occasion
The phase near events and preparing before going out
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized industry pressure of 'must perform excellently' and perfectionist standards, triggering catastrophic and comparative cognition
target_behavior.function: Temporarily easing decision pressure and uncertainty through avoidance and Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Less going out, declining participation, Persistent anxiety and Impaired self-esteem
